_comment: Per-domain mail provider. A domain is on EXACTLY ONE provider: enforcement
creates that provider's full record set and removes the other's, so a zone
never ends up with two MX sets pointing at different providers.
Anything not listed under 'domains' resolves to 'default'. To move a domain,
add or change its entry here FIRST, then dispatch 106 (or 103) with
mail_provider=from-registry. Nothing here runs on a schedule -- this file
records intent; a human still dispatches the workflow that acts on it.
